items.name: setup
items.title: Beamline source base
items.description: Editable runtime, tokens, foundation CSS and helpers in your repository; no Beamline packages.

items.name: look-prism
items.title: Prism look
items.description: Editable Prism look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono, instrument-serif).

items.description: Editable Soft look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono, inter). (Beamline complete system)

items.title: Glass look
items.description: Editable Glass look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono, inter). (Beamline complete system)

items.title: Glow look
items.description: Editable Glow look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono, inter). (Beamline complete system)

items.title: Blueprint look
items.description: Editable Blueprint look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono). (Beamline complete system)

items.name: look-mono
items.title: Mono look
items.description: Editable Mono look and local font assets (geist, geist-mono). (Beamline complete system)

items.name: look-metal
items.title: Metal look
items.description: Editable Metal look and local font assets (archivo, geist, geist-mono, inter).

items.name: look-pop
items.title: Pop look
items.description: Editable Pop look and local font assets (figtree, gabarito, geist-mono). (Beamline complete system)

items.name: look-ink
items.title: Ink look
items.description: Editable Ink look and local font assets (geist-mono, instrument-serif). (Beamline complete system)

items.name: account-security
items.title: Security
items.description: A person's account security on one page: how protected they are at a glance with the next step to take, password change with strength and rules, two-step sign-in set up by scanning a code, confirming one and saving recovery codes, passkeys added from the device and renamed in place, and every signed-in device with sign out one by one or everywhere else at once. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: admin-users
items.title: Admin users
items.description: Your staff's view of every account: headline counts that follow the filters, a virtualised users table with search, status and plan filters and sorting, bulk suspend (with a reason), reactivate, reset two-step sign-in, export and delete with Undo; a row opens the person in a side panel with their facts, workspaces and recent activity, and Sign in as them. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: agent-runs
items.title: Agent runs monitor
items.description: Every run of your agents in one place: success rate, run time, tokens and spend; the last runs as a strip of status blocks; a live table where running rows count up their time and cost; and a run's detail with its trace (thinking, each tool call with input and output, the answer or the error) and Retry or Cancel. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: agent-workspace
items.title: AI agent workspace
items.description: Threads, a conversation with streamed reasoning, cited answers and a plan that waits for approval then runs step by step, and an artifacts panel with changes, sources and files; it renders the run you give it and calls back for every decision. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: analytics-dashboard
items.title: Analytics dashboard
items.description: A SaaS overview in the app shell, fed by your metrics hook: range and segment filters drive KPIs, new and expansion revenue, channels, plan mix, uptime and the activity feed, with loading placeholders and a failed state with retry. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API keys & webhooks
items.description: The developer page of a SaaS: API keys with environment, scopes, last use and expiry, created through a form whose secret is shown once (copy it before you can leave), rotated with an overlap or revoked; and webhook endpoints with their recent deliveries as a status strip, opened in a side panel to switch on or off, send a test event, read each delivery's request and response, and resend it. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: artifact-workbench
items.title: Artifact workbench
items.description: Where the things an assistant makes are checked before they leave: every document, piece of code, small app and data result from a conversation, each version with what was asked for it, a live preview (the app runs in a sandbox, at desktop or phone width), the source, the changes from any earlier version, a failed version with Ask to fix, and Export in the format the work needs, with the file it made. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit log
items.description: Who did what, to what, when and from where, for a whole workspace: newest first and grouped by day, people with avatars and keys or systems with toned marks, sensitive actions flagged; filter by words, area, person and dates; open an entry for exactly what changed (before → after) and its request id; new entries wait above the list until shown; older pages load on demand; export the filtered log as CSV or JSON. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth page
items.description: The whole sign-in / sign-up route: product mark, a quiet dotted field with a light that follows the mouse, an optional notice, the SignIn and SignupForm cards switching in place with focus following, and legal links. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: billing
items.title: Billing & invoices
items.description: The billing page of a subscription: the plan with its seats and renewal, cancel and resume in place, the card on file with a checked update form, metered usage against the plan, the next invoice line by line, and the invoice history with status, PDF download and Pay now on a failed one; a failed payment leads the page with the one action that fixes it. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: changelog-feed
items.title: Changelog feed
items.description: An in-app What's new page: release notes grouped by month with tags, versions, pictures and details, a tag filter with counts, entries since your last visit marked as new, and a copyable link to each. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: contact-profile
items.title: Contact profile
items.description: One customer on one page: who they are and how to reach them (fields edit in place), their lifecycle stage and owner, the deals they are in with what is open, and the activity timeline with a composer to log a note, call, meeting or email, all optimistic. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: conversation-history
items.title: Conversation history
items.description: Past conversations with an assistant, ready to pick up again: the list by day with bookmarks and unsent drafts, a search through every message that groups hits by conversation and lands on the exact message, a link to a conversation or to one message that reopens it there, the versions of a conversation that branched (an edited question, a regenerated answer) with a switch on each message and a map of the branches, an interrupted answer with Continue, and a composer whose draft stays with its conversation when you open another. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: crm
items.title: CRM pipeline
items.description: A pipeline screen: KPIs and stage mix derived from a virtualised deals grid with inline edit, bulk moves and delete with undo; a row opens the deal in a side sheet with stage stepper, fields and notes. Every change goes to your onDealsChange. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: document-review
items.title: Document review
items.description: A PDF going through review: the document in the viewer with every comment pinned to its place, the reviewers' threads beside it (open or resolved, one opened at a time with its replies), what changed since the last version with each change marked in the page, a version switcher, and Approve or Request changes with a reason, both sent to your API and refused with the reason. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: empty-states
items.title: Empty states
items.description: The five empty moments every product has, written and wired: first use with a first step, no results with the filters to clear, an error with retry and a copyable error id, no permission with a request for access, and offline with reconnecting. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: file-manager
items.title: File manager
items.description: Files and folders in one screen: the views (My files, Shared, Recent, Starred, Trash) with storage at the foot, a folder tree beside the files, breadcrumb, search across folders, grid or list, Upload as the one primary action, and a file's preview, details, people and Share in a side panel; rename, trash, restore, star and share are optimistic. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: helpdesk-inbox
items.title: Helpdesk inbox
items.description: A support team's inbox: views with counts, a virtualised ticket queue with search, priority filters and live SLA clocks, and the open ticket with its conversation, reply composer, status, priority, assignee and the requester's details with internal notes. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: image-studio
items.title: AI image studio
items.description: Write a prompt, pick a shape, a style and how many, and watch the variations generate side by side; each one opens full screen and can be upscaled or used as the start of more like it. Every batch stays in a history you can step back to, with its prompt and settings. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: integrations
items.title: Integrations
items.description: A directory of the apps a product connects to: search and categories with counts, connected apps first with their state (Connected, Needs attention), a card per app with its mark, one line and one button that connects in place (waiting on the app's sign-in, then connected) or opens it; an app's side panel holds the connected account, sync history, its settings that save as they change, Sync now and Disconnect; no match offers Request an integration. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: invoices
items.title: Invoices
items.description: Accounts receivable in one screen: what is outstanding, overdue and paid, the invoices by status in a virtualised grid with bulk reminders, and each invoice opened as the document itself with its history and the one action its status calls for (send, record payment, download), all optimistic. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: knowledge-base
items.title: Knowledge base manager
items.description: What your assistant knows and whether it is fresh: sources with live sync status (syncing with progress, out of date, failed with the reason and Retry), the chunks each source became, and a test bench where you ask a question and see the cited answer beside the chunks it was built from. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: market-screener
items.title: Market screener
items.description: The whole market at a glance and a way to narrow it down: a sector heatmap, today's top movers with the market's breadth, ready-made screens (gainers, losers, most active, your watchlist) and a live table to search, sort and star markets into the watchlist. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: meeting-review
items.title: Meeting and call review
items.description: Everything a recorded call left behind on one screen: the recording with its transcript by speaker, an AI summary that streams in, action items with owners and due dates that each jump to the moment they were said, chapters, and who talked how much. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: model-playground
items.title: Model playground
items.description: Try one prompt on up to three models side by side: pick each model with its price and speed in view, set the system prompt, temperature and length once for all, run, and watch the answers write themselves while time to first token, speed, tokens and cost count up under each; when they finish, the fastest and the cheapest are marked. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: notification-preferences
items.title: Notification preferences
items.description: What reaches a person and where: events grouped by area down the side, channels (email, push, Slack, in-app) across the top, a switch per pair that saves on its own and steps back if refused, a column switch for a whole channel, channels that still need connecting, alerts that cannot be turned off, a digest, quiet hours and a pause for everything. In a narrow room each event carries its channels as a row of toggles. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: The first screen after sign-up: a welcome with how far set-up has come, a checklist of the few steps that make the product useful (each with why, how long it takes and one button that starts it), the next step opened and offered as the page's one primary action, done steps drawing their check and gathering at the end, steps that can be skipped and brought back, and a finished state with Hide this list; under it, guides to read or watch. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: order-history
items.title: Order history and fills
items.description: Every order the account placed and every fill it got, for a period: totals for volume, fees, fill rate and maker share; orders with their status and how much filled; each fill with its price, fee and maker or taker; an order opens with its fills and what happened when; and the view exports as CSV. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: orders-admin
items.title: Orders admin
items.description: A shop's order desk: today's orders and revenue, quick filters for what needs doing (to fulfil, unpaid, returns), a virtualised orders grid, and the chosen order beside it with its items, fulfilment steps, shipping and payment; fulfil with a carrier and tracking number, or refund chosen items, both optimistic. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: The top of a record or project page: breadcrumb, title with status, description and meta, a primary action with secondary actions that fold into a More menu when the width runs out, and tabs underneath; on long pages it can condense into a compact bar pinned to the top as you scroll. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: plan-comparison
items.title: Plan comparison
items.description: Plans side by side against every feature: prices that roll between monthly and yearly, the current and recommended plan marked, a header that stays in view while the features scroll, differences only, and included, not included and not specified told apart. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: portfolio
items.title: Portfolio overview
items.description: What an account holds and how it is doing: the total that rolls as prices tick with today's change, value over time against a benchmark, allocation by asset or sector, daily profit and loss, and every holding with its value, cost, unrealised P&L and weight. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: product-analytics
items.title: Product analytics
items.description: How people use the product: a funnel whose steps are the selector, where the people lost at a step went (saved as a cohort in one action), retention by sign-up cohort as a heat table, and the tracked events with their trends. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: project-board
items.title: Project board
items.description: A team's sprint as a board: the sprint's goal, points done and days left, filters by person and label, the work as cards in columns with work-in-progress limits, moves that are applied at once and refused with the reason, and a card opened beside the board with its details, estimate and discussion. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: projects
items.title: Projects
items.description: A team's projects: the portfolio by health (on track, at risk, off track) with progress, lead, team and due date, filtered and searched; a project opens in place to its overview — health and the latest status update, milestones, task mix, team and the update history — where posting the weekly update is the one primary action. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: report-builder
items.title: Report builder
items.description: Build a chart from your metrics without code: choose metrics, how to group them over time, an optional breakdown, filters, the range and the chart, see the chart and its numbers update as you choose, then save it as a named report (optimistic, with unsaved-changes and a refused save kept). (Beamline complete system)

items.name: roles-permissions
items.title: Roles & permissions
items.description: What each role may do, as one matrix: permissions grouped by area down the side, roles across the top with their head counts, a check per cell; a group's box sets the whole area. Edits gather in a draft whose changed cells are marked and counted in a save bar, risky grants are flagged, and custom roles can be created from an existing one or deleted with their people moved. In a narrow room it shows one role at a time. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: sales-dashboard
items.title: Sales dashboard
items.description: A sales leader's week in one screen: closed won against quota and pace, pipeline coverage and win rate, the quarter's run toward target with the forecast ahead of it, pipeline by stage, a rep leaderboard that scopes every figure to one rep, and the forecast call submitted to your API. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: Profile and workspace settings with one draft and a real save handler, on grouped panels: photo upload, time zone with the local time, appearance cards, notifications by channel, workspace security, members, plan and usage, API keys and a hold-to-confirm danger zone. Personal mode omits workspace data; optional profile fields share validation, persistence, error recovery and focus return.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: The sign-in card: email and password, a one-time code or a magic link, passkeys and single sign-on, with validation, progress, errors and a signed-in state; every step runs on your handlers. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Sign up form
items.description: The account creation card: single sign-on, name, work email and a password with strength and Caps Lock hints, terms consent, inline validation, your request's progress and errors, an emailed-code check and a finished state. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: social-scheduler
items.title: Social media scheduler
items.description: Plan posts across your social accounts: a week calendar where every post sits at its time in its account's colour and moves by drag, a queue of what goes out next with results for what already went, and a composer that writes once for several accounts, counts each one's character limit, previews the post as it will look and suggests the times your audience is around. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: status-dashboard
items.title: Status dashboard
items.description: An operations view of service health: the overall state in one line, every service with its status, uptime, latency now and 90 days of history, latency percentiles against the SLO, the live incident with its updates and a composer to post the next one, and past incidents. Declare incident when all is well, Post update when something is not. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: step-form
items.title: Step form
items.description: The finished frame for any multi-step form you compose — onboarding, intake brief, questionnaire, booking, application: a wide card with progress, the step's title and your fields, one accent Continue; a side panel with the steps and the answers so far (each with Edit); an automatic review step, sending and done. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: support-chat
items.title: AI support chat
items.description: The customer's side of AI support: an assistant that answers from your help centre with numbered citations, a thumbs up or down on every answer (a down asks why and offers a person), a handoff that queues, counts down the line and morphs the header into the person who joins, and a rating when the case ends. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: support-console
items.title: AI support console
items.description: The support team's side of AI support: a queue sorted by what is due first (who the assistant is still handling, who asked for a person, who waits), the conversation with the assistant's turns marked, a suggested reply that streams in with its sources and goes into the composer in one press, the customer's context and case summary, and the day's resolution rate, CSAT and first response. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: system-page
items.title: System pages
items.description: The four pages a product shows when the normal one cannot: page not found (search and the likely places), something broke (try again, an error id to quote, the status page), down for maintenance (when it is back, counting down, and Email me when it's back), and offline (retrying by itself with growing pauses, the changes waiting to sync, and Back online when it returns). One block, a kind each, on a quiet field of split light. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: team-calendar
items.title: Team calendar
items.description: A team's schedule: the people and shared calendars to show (each its colour), a month to jump by, who is out this week, and the week, day or month of events — drag to move or resize, drag across empty time to schedule, an event opened with its details and Cancel; every change optimistic and refused with the reason. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: team-chat
items.title: Team chat
items.description: A team's messages in one screen: channels and direct messages with unread counts and mentions, who is online, the conversation with reactions, receipts and who is typing, threads that open beside it, and every place you were mentioned in one list. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team & members
items.description: The people page of a workspace: seats used against the plan, members and pending invitations in one list with search and a role filter, role changes that apply at once and step back if your API refuses, invitations by pasted email list, and removal with Undo that only reaches your API once the Undo window closes. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: trading-terminal
items.title: Trading terminal
items.description: A perpetuals terminal on your feed and your account: ticker tape, market header with funding, candles, book / trades / depth, order ticket, account figures, positions and open orders. The terminal renders and calls the account; it never fills an order itself. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: voice-agent
items.title: Voice agent
items.description: A voice agent in three layouts on one session: a support panel that mixes typing and talking, a call screen with the agent's orb and one call button, and a workspace with an empty state, the live transcript and the conversation bar. One adapter connects any provider. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: workflow-builder
items.title: Workflow builder
items.description: Automation rules for a SaaS without code: a trigger, conditions built with the query builder that branch into Yes and No, actions and waits, drawn as a flow you edit step by step; test it on sample records and watch each step decide, read past runs with what every step did, pause it with a reason everyone sees, and publish the draft only after reading what changed against the live version. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace switcher
items.description: Moving between workspaces and making a new one: a switcher for the top of your sidebar (the current workspace's mark, name and plan; a searchable list with roles and unread counts; Create workspace) and a Choose a workspace page for after sign-in with waiting invitations to join or decline; both open the same three-step create dialog (name with its address checked as you type, a colour for its mark, teammates to invite) that ends in the new workspace. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Topics that open in place, one at a time or several: FAQs and settings sections; each header is a button (with an optional fact at its end), and the panel's height follows its content and can be reversed mid-way. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: A calendar of daily counts, one cell per day on a sequential ramp: weeks across, weekdays down, month and weekday labels, a legend scale, hatched days that were never recorded, and a keyboard grid that reads each day's date and value. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stays until it is dealt with: what happened, what to do, an action; danger and warning are announced; dismissing folds its height away.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A blocking confirmation that must be answered: the scrim does not dismiss it, focus starts on the safe choice, and an async action keeps it open until the work finishes.

items.name: allocation-editor
items.title: Allocation editor
items.description: Parts of a fixed whole edited as transfers: an ordered strip whose boundaries drag or step between neighbours and a roster of exact amounts where typing names the part that gives or takes; locks, limits and your rules refuse with words, nothing is redistributed out of sight, and Save waits for your handler. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A banner across the top for news and offers: messages take turns, a countdown ticks, and dismissing folds it away and can remember it. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: answer-compare
items.title: Answer compare
items.description: Two answers to the same prompt side by side, and a person's verdict: A is better, a tie, B is better, or both are bad, with the reasons that decided it. Answers stream in their own columns with time, tokens and cost under each; in a blind test the models stay hidden behind A and B until the verdict, then turn over to show who wrote what. Narrow rooms switch between the two instead of squeezing them. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The frame for every app screen: collapsible sidebar with grouped navigation, top bar and page. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval card
items.description: The agent stops and asks before it acts: what it wants to do, exactly what that changes, any choices it needs, and Approve or Reject; both run your callbacks with progress, a refusal says why with Retry, and a settled card folds to one line of record. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Amounts over time as filled areas: overlapping, stacked or as shares of 100%, five fills, two strokes, five curves, a range handle; gaps for missing values, a legend that toggles series and a table view of every number. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: Holds media, video and embeds at a fixed width-to-height ratio while the layout resizes. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file tile: preview or typed glyph with the type named, name, size, upload progress, error with retry, and a keyboard-reachable remove. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio player
items.description: One audio element and its controls: play with a loading state, a scrub bar with time, skip, speed and a playlist whose rows play into the same player. Use the ready layouts or compose the parts. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: availability-rule-editor
items.title: Availability rule editor
items.description: When someone (or something) can be booked: hours for each day of the week, one or more ranges a day, a day turned off, a day's hours copied to the others in one step, the time zone they are in, and exceptions for particular dates (a holiday off, a Saturday on). A week strip draws the hours at a glance, a sentence says them back, and overlapping or reversed ranges are said in words where they are. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or account in a small space: a photo, or initials on the hue their name always gets; presence dot; circle for people, square for companies.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: A team in a small space: overlapping faces that name themselves on hover or focus, and “+N” naming the rest. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status, category or count label: six tones, an icon or a status dot, two sizes.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Amounts by category as bars: columns or rows, grouped, stacked or as shares, reference lines, five looks (rounded, cells, trace, isometric, monospace), a header readout and a highlighted bar, on one data API; a missing value is a stub in its slot, never a zero bar. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar list
items.description: Ranked horizontal bars, label and value over a meter, one line per row when there is room — top pages, sources, customers. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: bar-visualizer
items.title: Bar visualizer
items.description: A row of bars that says what a voice agent is doing: a sweep while connecting, the person's voice while listening, a slow breath while thinking, the agent's voice while talking. Bars move only while there is something to show. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: bezel
items.title: Bezel
items.description: A double-bezel frame: an outer shell with a hairline, a small gap, and an inset panel with its own edge, so a preview, chart or media reads as set into the surface. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: A phone panel that rests at a peek and follows the finger to full height; a flick down closes it, and the handle works from the keyboard.

items.name: branch-navigator
items.title: Branch navigator
items.description: The versions of an assistant conversation that forked when a message was edited or an answer regenerated: a “‹ 2 / 3 ›” switch on each message that has alternates, and a map of the whole conversation where the path you are on runs straight down and every other version branches off it with how many turns it holds; choosing one shows that branch and lands on where it starts. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits and the way back up; it shows as many levels as its room holds and folds the ones nearest the top into a menu. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The action control: five weights and a brand fill, a buy/sell tone, sm/md/lg and a 44 px touch size, icon-only, a loading state that keeps its size and focus, and a label that changes in place.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grids for picking a day or a range: a real grid with arrows by day and week, Page keys by month, closed days, today's dot, and a range span that follows the pointer. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: call-grid
items.title: Call grid
items.description: The people on a video call, laid out for the room they are given: tiles as large as the space allows at the camera's shape, or the person talking (or a shared screen, or whoever you pin) large with everyone else in a strip; a ring that follows whoever is speaking, muted microphones, raised hands and weak connections said in words, a face when the camera is off, and the rest folded into "+N" when there are more people than room. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A record or a small group of related content and actions: optional media, avatar, title, status, action, meta, free content and a Details toggle; plain or double-bezel frame. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: card-field
items.title: Card field
items.description: A payment card in one field: the number groups as it is typed and names its network, the expiry and security code follow on their own as each part completes, the number is checked (length and checksum) and the expiry must be in the future; when it is complete and you move on, the number folds to its last four digits. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides that snap into place: swipe on touch, drag or the arrows with a mouse, ← → when focused, or the dots; optional autoplay that pauses and has a pause button. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: category-bar
items.title: Category bar
items.description: One bar split into labelled ranges with an optional marker that names its range. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat thread
items.description: People talking to people: messages grouped by person and day, reactions, delivery and read receipts that glide to the newest message read, who is typing, and a composer with files; it scrolls on the same scroller as the agent conversation. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A yes/no choice with an optional label and help, including the mixed state for select-all; the check draws itself in.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip group
items.description: Quick filters as chips: a chosen chip fills and grows a check, counts show what each would return, and extra chips fold behind “+N”.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline numbered citations that preview their source on hover or focus, plus a numbered source list; streamed answers flow in at an even pace with the list waiting for the end. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code to read and copy: highlighted in the system's colours, numbered, marked lines, long files folded behind “Show all”. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One region that opens and closes in place from its trigger, its height animating to the content. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: color-palette
items.title: Color Palette
items.description: A wheel of preset colours to pick from: twelve hues around the ring, their tints inward, white at the middle; the chosen swatch lifts and carries a check. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Colour picker
items.description: A swatch that opens a picker: saturation-brightness plane, hue strip, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH value to type or copy, the screen eyedropper where available, saved colours and the contrast on its background. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: One value from a long list found by typing (time zones, countries, customers): ranked matches with the match emphasised, keywords, optional group headings, clearable; the field keeps focus, and below 640 px the list opens as a bottom sheet with its own search.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: Search-first list of every action: ranked matching, groups, keycap shortcuts and nested pages; inline as CommandPalette or in a ⌘K dialog as CommandMenu. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment thread
items.description: A discussion attached to something: replies, reactions, @mentions, editing and deleting your own, resolve that folds the thread. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: composed-chart
items.title: Composed chart
items.description: Different measures on one time axis: bars, lines and areas per series, a left and a right value axis with their own formats, and reference lines. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: confirm-morph
items.title: Confirm morph
items.description: A destructive action that asks in place: the button morphs into its question, then into working, then into the result with Undo or Retry, without a dialog. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: context-cards
items.title: Context cards
items.description: The knowledge an agent retrieved before it answered: one card per chunk with what it is about, the text it read with the search words marked, how relevant it was and where it came from, filterable by source; optionally each chunk can be left out of the next answer. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Actions for an object on right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 or the menu key, opened at the pointer, with the same rows as the dropdown menu. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: The scrolling column of a conversation: follows new content while you are at the bottom, stops when you scroll up to read, and offers a way back; shared by the agent conversation and the people chat. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: conversation-bar
items.title: Conversation bar
items.description: The control bar of a voice call with an agent: one button to call and hang up, the agent's state as bars, a call timer, mute, and typing when talking is not an option. Works with any provider through one adapter, or with a session shared by the rest of the screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: Asks once which cookies a visitor allows, with Reject all and Accept all given equal weight; Customise grows the notice in place into each category with its switch, purpose and the cookies behind it; the choice is remembered (and asked again when your policy changes), and a browser's Global Privacy Control keeps marketing off. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value and confirms in place: the icon becomes a check and the label says Copied; a refused copy says so instead of pretending.

items.name: credit
items.title: Credit
items.description: "Designed with Beamline" for a site's footer: the Beamline mark and a quiet line, or a small badge. With your referral code, a team's first purchase through it earns you 30% as Beamline credit.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data grid
items.description: Virtualised local or server-driven grid: stable row IDs, manual sort and filters, pages or infinite loading, retry without losing rows, inline editing and keyboard navigation. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: One date in a form: a field that opens the month grid under it with focus inside, picks and closes; Today and Clear below, optional clear button. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A reporting range: presets on one side and two months on the other (one on a phone); the trigger names the preset in use, and the footer counts the days. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: depth-chart
items.title: Depth chart
items.description: Cumulative bid and ask depth as stepped areas around the mid, with hover readout. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description list
items.description: The details of one record as label and value pairs: beside each other or stacked, in as many columns as the room holds; a copy button arrives on the row you point at, long values fold behind Show more, a value that changes lights once, and a value never recorded is hatched, never blank or zero. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A focused task over the page (create, invite, rename) with a title, body and footer; focus moves in, is trapped and returns on close.

items.name: diff-table
items.title: Diff table
items.description: Proposed edits to a table before they happen: new rows green, removals struck through, changed cells old → new; each change can be left out and Apply runs the rest. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left for everything inside: text and logical spacing flip, and Radix parts read the direction for keys and placement. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: document-viewer
items.title: Document viewer
items.description: A PDF or a paged document read and marked up in place: page thumbnails beside it, zoom to the width, the page or a percentage, pages by keyboard, a search that marks every hit and steps through them, and annotations (highlight text or mark an area, attach a comment) listed beside the pages, each jumping to its place; pages not drawn yet are hatched, and loading, empty, failed and password-locked documents each say so. pdf.js loads only when a PDF is opened. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A list of actions behind a trigger, with shortcuts, check items, headings and submenus; one highlight glides under the pointer and jumps with the keyboard.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a place will hold and the first step to fill it, instead of a blank; a compact size for panels and filtered tables. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event calendar
items.description: A schedule of events by day, week or month: events that overlap sit side by side, drag one to another time or day or pull its bottom edge to change its length (or grab it with Space and use the arrows), drag across empty time to make a new one; a line marks now, and a narrow room shows three days or a month of dots with the chosen day's list. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: expandable-card
items.title: Expandable card
items.description: A dense card that grows in place when asked: the frame resizes and the clamped preview opens into the full text. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File diff
items.description: A change to one file as a unified diff: line numbers, tinted lines, only the changed words marked, long unchanged stretches folded; give rows or just before and after. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File drop zone
items.description: A generous target for files: drop or choose, each checked against type, size and count with the reason when turned away; uploads show progress and can be cancelled or retried. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: filter-toolbar
items.title: Filter toolbar
items.description: The filters on a list kept in view: chips that remove themselves, Add filter with fields and their values, Clear all, and room for search or view controls. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: flowchart
items.title: Flowchart
items.description: A workflow as steps on a dotted canvas: a trigger, conditions that branch into paths side by side, actions and waits, read top to bottom; during a run each step shows its status, and the whole flow is one keyboard stop walked with the arrows. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Validation wiring for react-hook-form (and zod) on the system's own fields: each field already links its label, help and error, so FormField hands over the value and the message. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: funding-countdown
items.title: Funding countdown
items.description: Perpetual funding rate with who pays, and a live countdown ring to the next funding. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: People or deals moving through ordered steps, each step a bar narrowing from the first: the part lost between two steps stays beside the next as a fading ghost with its count, the step's conversion and the conversion from the start read between them, a previous period shows as a mark on each bar with its change, and a step never measured is hatched rather than read as zero. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: gantt-chart
items.title: Gantt chart
items.description: A plan as bars on a timeline: tasks grouped down the side, each bar from its start to its end with its progress, milestones as diamonds, arrows from each task to the ones waiting on it (red, with the reason, when a task starts before what it waits on ends), a line at today and a day, week or month scale; drag a bar or its end, or grab it with Space and walk it with the arrows. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: One value against a known range: a semicircle, a 270° dial or a full ring, filled or with a needle, coloured bands with their names (healthy, busy, saturated), an optional target tick, the value large in the middle, and a meter that assistive technology reads. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: geo-map
items.title: Geo map
items.description: Values by country as a choropleth on the system's own world outline (no map service): classes from a sequential or diverging ramp with a legend you can point at to light one class, sized points for places, a ranked list beside it that previews and pins a country, a click that zooms to it, and countries never measured hatched; the outline loads only when a map is on screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: glow
items.title: Glow
items.description: Ambient light around one element that says something is happening: an aurora under a working composer, or a ring of light round a live card.

items.name: halftone-dots
items.title: Halftone Dots
items.description: A picture rebuilt as a field of dots whose size follows brightness; a new picture morphs the dots, a click ripples through, the pointer pushes dots aside. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Confirms a costly action by holding instead of clicking: a fill sweeps across while held and drains if let go early; pointer, touch, Space and Enter all hold.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview of a person, link or record on hover or keyboard focus, without leaving the page; HoverCardProfile is the standard person preview. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image compare
items.description: Two images in one frame with a divider: drag anywhere, or arrow keys on the handle; horizontal or vertical, with captions. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image cropper
items.description: Frame a picture before it is saved: a fixed window (square, round for avatars, wide for covers, or free with handles) over the picture, which you drag, zoom with the slider, wheel or a pinch, and turn a quarter at a time; it always covers the window, thirds lines show while you move it, and the arrow keys, + and − and R do the same from the keyboard. cropImage turns the result into a file. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image generation
items.description: The frame an AI image is generated into: a field of brand-hued pixels breathes with the progress while the model works, then the image arrives — sharpening from coarse blocks, sweeping in or fading — and a refusal says why. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: import-mapping
items.title: Import mapping
items.description: Map the columns of a file to the fields of one record type, see what every value becomes, then run the import and get an outcome for each row: suggestions are hints until accepted, ambiguous dates are named, and only failed rows are retried. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: inbox-list
items.title: Inbox list
items.description: Conversations waiting for a person, triaged in place: sender, subject and the first words, time, unread weight, star, labels and attachments, grouped by day; tick several for Archive, Mark read and Delete in a bar that grows over the header, or act on one from its row (hover, keyboard or a swipe on touch). Archived rows close up with Undo in their place. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Text that becomes a field in the same place: Enter (or ⌘Enter when multiline) saves, Escape cancels, leaving saves; saving shows progress and a refusal keeps the edit with the reason. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field with its label, help and error wired for assistive tech, three sizes and adornments.

items.name: input-dissolve
items.title: Input Dissolve
items.description: A one-line field whose text breaks into specks and drifts off once it is sent, last letter first; the field is empty and ready again. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: insight-cards
items.title: Insight cards
items.description: Findings from an agent, one per page: the sentence, the series it is about with their change, a chart to scrub that names each point, and a follow-up question. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: The generic list row: media, title, description, meta and trailing actions; becomes a link or button when interactive.

items.name: json-diff-viewer
items.title: JSON diff viewer
items.description: Two versions of a JSON value compared as one tree: added keys marked +, removed ones struck through with −, changed values read old → new, unchanged keys folded into a count you can open; array items are matched by their id (not their place) so a reorder is not a hundred changes, a summary counts each kind, and the next and previous change are one key away; only the rows in view are drawn. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JSON viewer
items.description: A JSON value as a tree you can read and walk: branches open and close (one level, or all at once), closed ones preview what they hold, every value reads by its type, search marks and opens its way to each match, any row copies its path or its value, and values that change light once; only the rows in view are drawn. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: Work as cards in columns by stage: drag a card (or lift it with Space and walk it with the arrows) to another column or place, the cards around it make room as it travels; columns keep work-in-progress limits that warn or refuse, fold into a narrow rail, and swipe one by one in a narrow room. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys as keycaps, for combinations and sequences (G then A); `mod` resolves to ⌘ or Ctrl per platform, symbols are spoken as words.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The text label tied to a form control, with a required marker that screen readers announce.

items.name: light-band
items.title: Light band
items.description: A band of split light in the dark behind a section, blue at one end and amber at the other with a bright core: Prism's light at a chosen place, a hero, the plan you sell or the closing call to action. Drawn live by default: it turns slowly in depth like a ribbon and its spectrum flows, more while the page moves; it moves at its own depth as its section passes, and a pulse of light runs along it while the page scrolls. It moves while something happens (its first run, a scroll, the pointer over its section, a resize) and for 9 s after, then eases to rest and does no work until woken. Without WebGL, on a light page or under reduced motion it is the painted band. Draws only on screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A full-screen image viewer: a thumbnail grows into it and shrinks back, arrows and ←/→ step through the set, Esc or a downward drag closes it. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Values over time as lines: curves, point markers, dashed series for forecasts, reference lines for limits and targets, an optional zero baseline and a range handle; missing values break the line. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: liquid-gooey
items.title: Liquid gooey
items.description: Liquid surfaces that merge like goo when they touch — split plus-menus, gooey switches, file chips. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: live-cursors
items.title: Live cursors
items.description: Who else is working on this, and where: over any shared surface, each person's pointer in the colour their name always gets, with a name flag, gliding between the positions your realtime service sends; their selections outlined in the same colour, a short message beside the pointer when they type one (press / for your own), quieter when they go idle and fading when they leave. Positions are fractions of the surface, so every screen size agrees. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: live-waveform
items.title: Live waveform
items.description: Loudness drawn as it happens: a scrolling history of the microphone (or any live source) or its spectrum, a calm processing state while words are finished, and a number readout under reduced motion. Draws only while there is sound to draw and it is on screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: log-viewer
items.title: Log viewer
items.description: Log lines as they stream: it follows the newest line until you scroll up, then counts what arrived and brings you back in one click; filter by level with counts, search with every match marked and stepped through, wrap long lines, open a line's fields; only the lines in view are drawn, so a hundred thousand stay smooth. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: logo-carousel
items.title: Logo Carousel
items.description: A wall of logos shown a few at a time: every few seconds the slots turn left to right, each logo leaving upward as the next rises in. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A labelled point in a stream: a status event with an icon between messages, or a label such as "Today" between two hairlines. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: market-heatmap
items.title: Market heatmap
items.description: Treemap of markets sized by weight and coloured by change, grouped by sector, with hatched no-data tiles. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: matrix
items.title: Matrix
items.description: A dot-matrix display: animated frame sets (loading, pulse, wave, syncing), text and digits in a 5×7 font, or a VU meter of levels or a live source. One canvas; the loop runs only while something moves and it is on screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: mention-input
items.title: Mention input
items.description: A composer where @people and #channels become single tokens with suggestions at the caret; the value keeps the text and where each mention sits. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menu bar
items.description: A desktop-style File / Edit / View bar for editor-like apps; each menu takes the same rows as the dropdown menu, and pointing moves between open menus. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn in a conversation with an agent: the person's words in a quiet bubble, the agent's answer on the page with its orb mark, trace, tool calls and actions, or what went wrong with the way forward. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric card
items.description: A KPI that fills its tile: label, a value that rolls to each new number, the change with arrow, sign and tone, what it compares with and the value it was, a trend line and context; a wide tile sets the trend beside the figures. Unmeasured values are hatched, never zero. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: mic-selector
items.title: Microphone selector
items.description: Choose the microphone, test it with a live level and mute it, with every permission and device state spelled out: not yet allowed, blocked (and how to unblock), no microphone, unplugged. Shares its microphone with the rest of the screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: Choose the AI model for a request by what it can do and what it costs: a trigger with the model's name opens a searchable list grouped by provider, with capability filters, and every row shows its context window, speed and price tier; the model under the pointer or the arrow keys explains itself beside the list. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Several values from a known list as removable chips in the field; the list has a search field (for long lists), checkable rows and a count with Clear. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A site or docs header whose sections open into one panel that resizes and slides between them; NavigationMenuCard is the standard link row. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification centre
items.description: Updates that wait to be read: a bell with the unread count opens All / Unread, new and earlier groups, and per item mark read or dismiss. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A bounded number with − and +: arrows and Page keys step, typing is read in the locale and clamped on leaving, limits can be explained, and the label can scrub. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: options-chain
items.title: Options chain
items.description: Calls and puts for one expiry around a centre column of strikes: bid, ask, implied volatility, delta, volume and open interest, the money shaded in, a spot line that moves through the strikes as the price ticks, and quotes that flash as they change; clicking a bid sells and an ask buys, and the chosen legs add up to a net debit or credit. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: The agent's presence: a thin ring of light around a lens in the brand's hue that holds still at rest, sends an arc round while thinking and widens with the voice; from a 16px agent mark to a 240px voice screen. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order book
items.description: Asks, spread and bids with cumulative depth bars, grouping, change flashes and keyboard price picking. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: order-ticket
items.title: Order ticket
items.description: Buy/sell order entry with limit, market and stop types, % of balance, inline validation and a live cost summary. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: A verification code in separate boxes backed by one real field, so paste, SMS autofill and Backspace work; optional groups like 123–456. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through pages of a known length: first, last and the current page's neighbours, with an optional “41–60 of 468”. It answers to its own room: narrow, “Page 6 of 24”; wide, one more neighbour on each side.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: A password field with a reveal control, and a strength meter when a password is being created. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: A phone number with its country: searchable picker with country and dialling codes, “+44…” switches the country, the number groups as typed, and the value is E.164. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie chart
items.description: A few shares of a whole as a pie or donut, with spaced slices, percent labels, a centre readout and a list of every slice with value and share; hovering or focusing a row lifts its slice, clicking pins it. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: pivot-table
items.title: Pivot table
items.description: Records summed up by the fields people choose: rows grouped by one or more fields that fold open level by level, columns split by another, one or more measures (sum, count, average, min, max) in every cell, subtotals on every group and totals at the end; fields move between Rows, Columns and Values from a menu on each chip, the table rearranges with rows sliding to their new places, cells can be shaded by their size, and a cell with no records stays blank while one whose values were never measured is hatched. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: An agent's plan: numbered steps with live status, progress, and Approve / Edit / Reject when it needs sign-off; approving shows progress, and a refusal says why and keeps waiting. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: pnl-calendar
items.title: P&L calendar
items.description: A trader's month at a glance: every trading day's profit or loss in its cell, shaded deeper the bigger it was in the gain or loss colour and marked ▲ or ▼, week totals down the side, and the month's total, win days and best and worst day on top; days the account did not trade stay plain and days that were never recorded are hatched. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small surface anchored to a trigger for a short form, a filter or an explanation; focus moves in and returns on close. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: positions-table
items.title: Positions table
items.description: Open positions with live unrealised PnL, liquidation warnings and close actions. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: price-chart
items.title: Price chart
items.description: Candles, line or area price chart with volume, OHLC legend and reference lines, built for live ticks. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: price-ticker
items.title: Price ticker
items.description: Symbol, last price with a directional flash, 24h change and stats. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: product-tour
items.title: Product tour
items.description: A short guided tour over the real interface: a spotlight that glides from one element to the next while the rest of the screen dims, and a card beside each element that says what it does, with its step and progress, Back, Next and Skip; focus moves into the card and comes back where it was, Escape ends the tour, arrows step through it, and a quieter beacon variant marks one new thing without dimming anything. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How much of a known task is done, or a moving bar when the length is unknown, with an optional label and value. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt bar
items.description: The agent composer: a field that grows, @ to add a source, / for a command, a model picker, files and dictation, and one button that sends with progress and becomes Stop while the answer arrives; a refused send keeps the draft and says why. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt suggestions
items.description: Ready-made prompts a person can start from or follow up with: chips, cards or a list; a picked one lifts off and flies into the composer as its text, while follow-ups that are still being written hold their place and arrive one after another. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A scannable code set as gradient dots with rounded finder rings and an optional centre mark; a new value ripples out from the centre. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: query-builder
items.title: Query builder
items.description: Conditions people build by hand to pick out records: each rule is a field, an operator that fits the field (contains, between, in the last N days, is any of) and a value in the right control; rules join with and or or, groups nest them, the joining word toggles in place, an unfinished rule says so instead of counting, the query reads back as a sentence, and the number of matches rolls as it changes. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: A few series compared across the same five to eight dimensions as polygons on a polygon or circle grid; hover or arrow keys pick a dimension and read every series' value there. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: radial-chart
items.title: Radial chart
items.description: Progress of a few measures toward their targets as concentric rings, full or half circle, with a centre readout and a list of each ring's value, target and percent. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio cards
items.description: One choice among rich options as cards with optional media, icon, detail and a figure; one selection ring follows the stable choice.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a short visible set, each option with an optional description, vertical or in a row. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A score on a small scale: stars that fill as you point (halves too) and light one after another when chosen, with the word for the score beside them; read-only it shows an average to the tenth with its count, and nothing rated yet is hatched; or a 0–10 scale with its two ends named for likelihood questions. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The agent's trace, fed by your stream: a shimmering label and the seconds so far while it works, then "Thought for N seconds"; steps that check off, prose thoughts, search sources or tool calls, open while running and folded when done. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: recommendation-card
items.title: Recommendation card
items.description: One suggestion from the agent that the person may take or leave: what it suggests, why, the expected effect and how sure it is (a meter and a word, hatched when it cannot tell), with the alternatives it weighed one click away; Accept runs your callback with progress and the card settles to one line. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: recurrence-editor
items.title: Recurrence editor
items.description: How something repeats, set in plain controls and said back in a sentence: every N days, weeks, months or years; which weekdays; in a month, on a date or on the second Tuesday (or the last Friday); ending never, on a date or after a number of times. The next dates are listed so the rule can be checked against a calendar, months without the chosen date are said, and the rule comes out as a value and an iCalendar RRULE. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: resizable-panels
items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: Panes that trade space across draggable dividers; each divider is a focusable separator with arrow keys, limits, folding for collapsible panes and double-click to restore. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: response
items.title: Response
items.description: An assistant's answer as streamed markdown in the system's reading type: bursty tokens flow in at an even pace, each new word fades in through a short brand-hue colour trail, code is highlighted in the system's colours, and tables and quotes are set cleanly. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: A Notion-grade writing surface: slash menu for every block, a formatting toolbar on selection, drag-to-move blocks, nesting, markdown shortcuts, paste from the web or as markdown; outputs HTML, Markdown and JSON. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: ridgeline
items.title: Ridgeline
items.description: Distributions per group as overlapping density ridges (response time by region, order size by plan): an overlap control, median and p95 readouts per row, hover or focus a ridge to bring it forward with its markers, and hatched rows for groups that were not measured. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: run-trace
items.title: Run trace
items.description: One agent run as a waterfall: every step (model calls, tools, retrieval, checks, sub-agents) nested under the step that started it, each a bar on a shared time axis, with retries as separate attempts on the same bar, tokens and cost per step and for the run; while it runs the bars grow live, and choosing a step shows its timing, attempts, input and output beside the trace. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey chart
items.description: Flows between stages as bands whose width is the amount: sources to pages to outcomes, budgets to teams; hovering or focusing a node lights its flows and reads its totals in and out. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter chart
items.description: Two measures of many items against each other, one point per item, or a bubble chart when a third measure sizes the points: groups by colour and shape with a legend that turns them off, optional quadrants with their names and a trend line, the nearest point read on hover or walked with the arrow keys, and items missing a value counted as not measured instead of placed at zero. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A native scroll region with thin overlay thumbs and edge fades that show only where more content waits; thumbs can be dragged or clicked. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: scrub-bar
items.title: Scrub bar
items.description: A seekable timeline for audio or video: elapsed and total time, what has loaded, chapter marks, a time preview under the pointer, and the full keyboard of a media slider. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: The search entry point: magnifier, clear button, Escape to clear, a shortcut hint and an optional live border beam.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Two to five views or ranges of the same content (1D / 1W / 1M, List / Board): a radio group whose raised thumb slides to the choice.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a short known list, in the same frame as every text field: label, help, error, option groups and details.

items.name: selection-actions
items.title: Selection actions
items.description: Select a passage and hand it to the agent: a bar over the selection with quick actions, your own instruction and More; while the agent works it says so, and its suggestion comes back to Replace, Copy or Discard, with the passage kept marked. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical; hidden from screen readers unless it carries meaning. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: share-dialog
items.title: Share dialog
items.description: Share a document, board or project: invite people by name or email with the access they get, change or remove anyone's access in place, and set who the link opens for, with Copy link; inviting turns the dialog into the invitation (role, notify, a note) and back. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge with the page still visible behind it: header and footer stay put while the body scrolls. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut recorder
items.description: Lets people set their own shortcut: press the keys, see them as keycaps; a clash or a browser-kept shortcut asks first. ShortcutCheatsheet lists every shortcut, searchable. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's main navigation: sections, items with counts and one level of sub-pages, an icon rail with tooltips (⌘B, the trigger or the edge), and a sheet on phones. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature pad
items.description: A pad for a drawn signature whose ink follows a stylus's pressure (and thins with speed under a mouse or finger); undo, replay, PNG or SVG export, and typing instead for keyboards and screen readers. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Holds the shape of content while it loads, then crossfades into it, so nothing jumps. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value or range on a known scale: the thumb grows under the finger and shows its value while dragged or focused; marks, end icons and a value readout. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: slope-chart
items.title: Slope chart
items.description: Change between two points in time per item, by value or by rank: labels on both sides that never collide, rising and falling told by the end marker (▲ ▼) and the signed change as well as colour, and hover or focus to pick one item out. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: slot-text
items.title: Slot text
items.description: Text and numbers that roll into their new value on reels, digit by digit from the right; other characters fade. Read as plain text by assistive tech.

items.name: sound
items.title: Sound
items.description: Opt-in interface cues with scoped volume, graceful mute and bounded repetition; soft tactile gestures and restrained result tones. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A compact trend beside its value: point along it or focus it and use ← → to read each point; nulls are gaps. TrendLine is the bare line. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: speech-input
items.title: Speech input
items.description: A text field you can speak into: the mic dictates through any speech-to-text provider, the phrase being heard shows apart from the finished words, and every failure (blocked, no microphone, connection lost and back) says what to do. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A ring that spins while work runs and closes into a drawn check or cross when it ends.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: One obvious action joined to a menu of close alternatives; both halves are real buttons and the menu uses the shared menu rows. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Where someone is in a multi-step flow: done steps carry a check, the current one a ring, and the line between marks fills as steps complete. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: streamgraph
items.title: Streamgraph
items.description: Stacked flows over time around a centre baseline, with silhouette, wiggle, expand (shares) and zero offsets: a legend that turns layers on and off, a tooltip that follows the pointer or the arrow keys, and hatched periods where a layer was not measured. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: swap-form
items.title: Swap form
items.description: Exchange one token for another: type what you pay (or Max), pick each token from a searchable list with balances, and the form quotes what you receive with the rate, price impact, minimum after slippage and fees; the quote refreshes as it ages, the two sides trade places with one press, Review shows exactly what will happen, and the swap reports its progress, result or reason. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: Row actions behind a swipe on touch screens and a two-finger swipe on a trackpad, and at the row's end for pointer and keyboard (a ⋯ menu in a narrow row, icon buttons in a wide one); a full swipe runs the edge action. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that applies at once: a thumb that slides on a spring and stretches under the finger, with an optional label before or after.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A native HTML table for small datasets, composed with children or driven by records; shared server paging, sorting, filters, search, stable-ID selection and retry.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of contents
items.description: The sections of a long page beside it, with the one being read marked as you scroll: the marker travels down the rail between sections, the rail fills with how far you have read, a click glides to the section and hands it focus; the quiet variant is a column of ticks that opens into names when pointed at, and a narrow room folds it into one “On this page” line. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between panels of one object; one indicator slides to the active tab, counts sit beside labels, and the tabs a row has no room for fold into More.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Short free-form values as tags: Enter, comma or Tab adds, a pasted list adds them all, Backspace twice removes the last; duplicates and invalid values are said, not dropped silently.

items.name: task-rows
items.title: Task rows
items.description: Background work an agent is doing, one row per task: status as a glyph and a word, what it produced, how long it has run or took, a progress bar while running and its sub-steps when opened; a failure opens with its reason and Retry, live tasks can be cancelled, and changes are announced politely. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text morph
items.description: A short label that becomes its next state letter by letter: shared letters glide into place, new ones arrive, old ones leave.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: A headline whose words rise into place once, the first time it scrolls into view; never repeats. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text shimmer
items.description: Ongoing work said in words (“Thinking…”) with a calm band of light passing across them; stops when inactive. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line plain text that grows with what is typed up to a limit, with an optional character count. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: The light/dark control: the page changes in one of four transitions starting from the button (reveal, eclipse, split, rise), and the icon turns between sun and moon. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: ticker-tape
items.title: Ticker tape
items.description: A continuously scrolling row of symbols with price, change and mini trend; anyone can hold it: hover, keyboard focus or a tap. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: A time of day as hour and minute segments, typed or stepped, 12- or 24-hour; the clock opens a list of times at the step. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: What happened, newest first and grouped by day: people with avatars, systems with toned icons, relative times with the exact time on hover, details in place. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short results of an action stacked at an edge: point at the stack to fan it out and pause the timers; undo or retry in place; Alt+T, Escape and a swipe for the keyboard and touch.

items.name: toggle-group
