items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Pressable toggles where one or several can be on: alignment, bold and italic, view options; bare for toolbars or framed. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: One tool call in an agent's run: status, what it did and a short result on one quiet row that opens to the exact input and output; stops for permission when needed, with progress and the reason if allowing fails. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short supporting text for a control: opens after a moment on hover and at once on keyboard focus; inside a toolbar group the next one opens instantly.

items.name: tracker
items.title: Tracker
items.description: A row of status blocks for uptime, job runs or daily checks, with tooltips and a legend. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: trades-tape
items.title: Trades tape
items.description: Recent trades, newest first, with side glyphs, large-print marking and one-time arrival flashes. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: transcript-viewer
items.title: Transcript viewer
items.description: A recording and its words together: the spoken word lights up as it plays and the transcript follows it, any word or paragraph time plays from there, speakers become paragraphs with marks on the scrub bar. Takes word timings from speech-to-text or character alignment from text-to-speech. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: tree-select
items.title: Tree select
items.description: A field that picks from a tree: departments and teams, categories and subcategories, folders, regions and cities; the list opens as an indented tree whose branches fold, search keeps the path to every match and opens it, one value shows its whole path in the field, and several values tick whole branches at once (a branch half chosen shows a dash) and fold a fully chosen branch into one chip. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: Nested folders and records with the full tree keyboard model (arrows, Home/End, *, type to jump), depth guides, counts and animated opening. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Nested rectangles sized by value (spend by team, then service), squarified so tiles stay close to square: labels that fit or hide, hover and focus highlight, drill in with a click or Enter and out with Escape, Backspace or the breadcrumb, hatched chips for parts that were not measured, and a table of the current level. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: ui-root
items.title: UI root
items.description: Makes a region of any app a Beamline root: theme, brand and direction for everything inside, and a matching layer at page level where its menus, dialogs and tooltips open.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: An allowance and what fills it: one bar split by source, the room left, a warning near the limit and the overflow in its own red well past a notch at the limit.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User menu
items.description: The account menu behind the avatar: who is signed in, status, theme, account pages and sign out with progress; a bottom sheet on phones. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: video
items.title: Video player
items.description: A video player on the native <video> element: title bar with an external link and close, centre play with ±10 s, scrub, time, volume, speed, captions drawn in the system's type, picture-in-picture and fullscreen; full keyboard control, and loading, buffering, ended and error states. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: voice-button
items.title: Voice button
items.description: The control that starts and stops talking: click to toggle or hold to talk (pointer, Space, Enter or a global shortcut), with a live level while recording, a loader while words are finished, and a check or a retry when it ends. The state comes from your operation, never from a timer. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: voice-picker
items.title: Voice picker
items.description: Choose a text-to-speech voice from a searchable list (name, accent, tone, use) and hear it first: each voice has its own orb, previews play one at a time and the orb speaks while its sample plays. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: waffle-chart
items.title: Waffle chart
items.description: Units of a whole as a grid of cells by category (seats used of a plan, tickets by channel): a 10×10 grid by default, hatched cells for units whose category was not recorded, the remainder left empty, and a list of categories with counts and shares that highlights its cells on hover or focus. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: watchlist
items.title: Watchlist
items.description: A selectable, sortable list of markets with mini trends, prices, changes and stars. (Beamline complete system)

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: The shape of a recording: one bar per slice of loudness, fitted to any width, with the played part in the accent, unmeasured slices hatched and a loading state. Peaks can be decoded from the file in the browser. (Beamline complete system)
